item.title: Model Context Protocol Docs
item.description:
The official home for the Model Context Protocol specification: how the handshake works, how tools and resources are defined, and reference documentation for building both clients and servers.

Start here if you want to understand MCP at the protocol level rather than just using pre-built servers from the directory.

item.title: Claude Code GitHub Repository
item.description:
The public GitHub repository backing Claude Code — where releases are tracked, issues are filed, and changes to the CLI agent are documented over time.

Useful for checking what changed in a recent release, filing a bug, or seeing how other users are running into and working around specific issues.
